text: 金十数据8月9日讯，国家统计局城市司首席统计师董莉娟：从同比看，全国PPI上涨3.5%，涨幅比上月回落0.6个百分点。分行业看，价格上涨的主要行业中，石油和天然气开采业、石油煤炭及其他燃料加工业、化学原料和化学制品制造业分别上涨3.2%、8.2%和9.1%，有色金属矿采选业、有色金属冶炼和压延加工业分别上涨22.6%和20.2%，黑色金属冶炼和压延加工业上涨2.7%，涨幅比上月均回落，6个行业合计影响PPI同比上涨约2.55个百分点；煤炭开采和洗选业上涨27.1%，电气机械和器材制造业上涨5.7%，计算机通信和其他电子设备制造业上涨4.4%，涨幅比上月均
text_en: Jin Shi Data, August 9 - NBS Chief Statistician of the Urban Department Dong Lijuan: Year-on-year, the national PPI rose 3.5%, with the increase down 0.6 percentage points from the previous month. By industry, among the main industries with rising prices, oil and natural gas extraction, petroleum, coal and other fuel processing, and chemical raw materials and chemical products manufacturing rose 3.2%, 8.2%, and 9.1% respectively; non-ferrous metal mining and dressing, and non-ferrous metal smelting and rolling processing rose 22.6% and 20.2% respectively; ferrous metal smelting and rolling processing rose 2.7%, with all increases lower than the previous month, and these six industries together contributed about 2.55 percentage points to the year-on-year PPI increase; coal mining and washing rose 27.1%, electrical machinery and equipment manufacturing rose 5.7%, and computer, communication and other electronic equipment manufacturing rose 4.4%, with increases all lower than the previous month.
